[[File:ThreepioPlastron-Fathead.png|thumb|right|250px|Plastron on a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] unit.]]
A '''plastron''' was the name of the broad piece of material covering the ventral (belly) side of upright, bipedal [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It functioned as a protective covering for their internal circuitry and components. [[BLX-5|Bollux]] the [[BLX labor droid]] was fitted with an airtight, hinged plastron, in which was housed the [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]], [[Blue Max]].
